title: Vintage Fender Jaguar Value Guide: 1962 To 1975 Prices
description: Vintage Fender Jaguar values for every year from 1962 to 1975, with dated sale comparisons, original finish, repairs, cases and photos from my archive.
alt: Olympic White Fender Jaguar body with tortoiseshell pickguard, two pickups and chrome controls

faqs.q: How Much Is A Vintage Fender Jaguar Worth?
faqs.a: As of October 2026, the sunburst ranges span $3,500 to $9,000 across the original 1962 to 1975 run. First-year examples sit at $6,000 to $9,000, while the 1970s range is $3,500 to $4,500. Condition, originality and case completeness affect the appraisal.

faqs.q: What Is A 1965 Fender Jaguar Worth?
faqs.a: The 1965 range is $4,000 to $5,500, with condition and case completeness assessed individually. I check the actual transition features, original finish, pickups and required work before applying it.

faqs.q: Why Do Some Years Share A Price Range?
faqs.a: Adjacent years can share an era range. The actual condition, configuration and included accessories still determine the appraisal. I don't apply an automatic annual premium.

faqs.q: Does An Original Custom Color Have A Fixed Premium?
faqs.a: No. The color, originality and condition affect the premium. A rare-color asking price doesn't establish what an ordinary sunburst or a refinished guitar will bring.

faqs.q: How Does A Refinish Affect Jaguar Value?
faqs.a: A refinish changes the collector comparison, even if the work is attractive and the guitar plays well. I compare it with other refinished examples and account separately for routing, repairs and changed parts. There isn't one percentage that describes every guitar.

faqs.q: Does A Quality Refret Change The Originality Category?
faqs.a: A quality refret is accepted maintenance and preserves the all-original classification of an otherwise all-original guitar. It takes the instrument out of the museum-quality category. Neck reshaping and fingerboard alterations are separate changes.

faqs.q: Is A Dealer Offer The Same As The Table Price?
faqs.a: No. The table is a market comparison with stated conditions. A purchase offer has its own terms, while a private seller's proceeds depend on fees, shipping, repairs and the final agreement. I explain the comparison and the proposed offer separately.
